facts.text: I have been playing my new acoustic guitar a lot lately.
I bought a Fender FA-125 for $300 last month.
I am enjoying playing my Fender FA-125 acoustic guitar.
I have been taking weekly lessons with Alex.
Alex has been helping me with my fingerpicking skills.
I realize I need to focus on chord transitions.
I am thinking of getting a guitar amp to go with my Fender FA-125.
I misunderstood the type of amp I need.
I am actually looking for an electric guitar amp.
I have been thinking of getting an electric guitar in the future.
I think I will get the Fender Mustang LT25 amp.
I have heard great things about the Fender Mustang LT25 amp.
The Fender Mustang LT25 amp is in my budget.
I have been considering setting up a practice routine with my new guitar and amp.

events.text: Planned to get a guitar amp to go with the Fender FA-125.
